doc_description: Ulta Beauty’s March 9, 2023 press release reports record Q4 and FY2022 results (periods ended Jan 28, 2023)—Q4 sales $3.23B (comps +15.6%) and EPS $6.68; full-year sales $10.21B, EPS $24.01, 47 new stores—achieving milestones of >$10B revenue, >$1B net income, and 40M+ Rewards members, and providing FY2023 guidance of $10.95–$11.05B sales and $24.70–$25.40 EPS.

structure.title: Ulta Beauty Announces Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2022 Results
structure.heading: Ulta Beauty Announces Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2022 Results
structure.start_phrase: BOLINGBROOK, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Ulta Beauty, Inc. (NASDAQ: ULTA) today announced financial results for the thirteen-week period (“fourth quarter”) and fifty-two-week period (“fiscal year”) ended January 28, 2023 compared to the same periods ended January 29, 2022.
structure.summary:
- Ulta Beauty reported fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2022 results for the periods ended January 28, 2023, highlighting record performance.
- Q4 2022 highlights: net sales $3.23B (+18.2% year over year), comparable sales +15.6%, gross margin 37.6%, operating margin 13.9%, SG&A $762.7M, net income $340.8M, diluted EPS $6.68, and 12 net new store openings.
- FY 2022 highlights: net sales $10.21B, comparable sales +15.6%, gross margin 39.6%, operating margin 16.1%, SG&A $2.40B, diluted EPS $24.01, and 47 net new store openings; comparative figures for FY2021 and FY2020 are provided.
- CEO commentary notes an exceptional year with record sales, profitability, and member growth; milestones include surpassing $10B in annual revenue, exceeding $1B in annual net income, and topping 40 million Ultamate Rewards members.
- Outlook: management remains optimistic about the beauty category in fiscal 2023, aiming to expand leadership, gain market share, and deliver long-term value.
- Q4 sales growth drivers: continued strength of the beauty category, retail price increases, and contributions from new brands and product innovation.

nodes.title: For the Fourth Quarter of Fiscal 2022
nodes.heading: For the Fourth Quarter of Fiscal 2022
nodes.start_phrase: Net sales increased 18.2% to $3.2 billion compared to $2.7 billion in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2021 primarily due to the favorable impact from the continued resilience of the beauty category, retail price increases, and the impact of new brands and product innovation compared to the fourth quarter of fiscal 2021.
nodes.summary:
- Ulta Beauty’s March 9, 2023 press release announces fourth quarter and full-year fiscal 2022 results (periods ended January 28, 2023).
- Headline Q4 results: net sales $3.23B vs. $2.73B prior year; comparable sales +15.6%; net income $340.8M; diluted EPS $6.68.
- Full-year results: net sales $10.21B vs. $8.63B; comparable sales +15.6%; net income $1.24B; diluted EPS $24.01.
- Profitability metrics: Q4 gross margin 37.6% (flat YoY); operating margin 13.9% (vs. 13.8%). Full-year gross margin 39.6% (vs. 39.0%); operating margin 16.1% (vs. 15.0%).
- SG&A: Q4 $762.7M (23.6% of sales, down from 23.8%); full year $2.40B (23.5% of sales, down from 23.9%).
- Comparable sales drivers: Q4 transactions +13.6% and average ticket +1.8%; full year transactions +10.8% and average ticket +4.3%.
- Growth drivers cited: resilience of the beauty category, retail price increases, new brands and product innovation; plus increased social occasions and fewer COVID-19 limitations for the full year.
- Gross margin dynamics: leverage of fixed costs, favorable channel mix, and strong growth in other revenue; partially offset by higher inventory shrink (and lower merchandise margin for the full year).
- Expense dynamics: leverage in marketing and incentive compensation; partially offset by higher store payroll/benefits from wage investments and higher corporate overhead due to strategic investments.
- Tax rate higher YoY: Q4 24.6% (vs. 22.9%); full year 24.4% (vs. 23.9%).
- EPS details: Q4 $6.68 includes $0.02 tax benefit from stock-based comp (prior year included $0.05).
- Store growth: 12 net new stores in Q4; 47 net new stores in fiscal 2022.
- CEO commentary highlights record sales, profitability, and member growth; milestones include surpassing $10B in annual revenue, $1B in annual net income, and 40M+ Ultamate Rewards members.
- Outlook tone: optimism for fiscal 2023, with focus on expanding leadership, capturing market share, and creating long-term stakeholder value.

nodes.title: For the Full Year of Fiscal 2022
nodes.heading: For the Full Year of Fiscal 2022
nodes.start_phrase: Net sales increased 18.3% to $10.2 billion compared to $8.6 billion in fiscal 2021, primarily due to the favorable impact from the continued resilience of the beauty category, retail price increases, the impact of new brands and product innovation, increased social occasions, and fewer COVID-19 limitations compared to fiscal 2021.
nodes.summary:
- Q4 FY2022 performance:
  - Comparable sales up 15.6% (transactions +13.6%, average ticket +1.8%).
  - Gross profit up 18.0% to $1.2B; gross margin flat at 37.6% (fixed cost leverage, favorable channel mix, other revenue growth offset by higher inventory shrink).
  - SG&A up 17.3% to $762.7M; SG&A rate improved to 23.6% (marketing and incentive comp leverage) offset by wage investments and strategic corporate investments.
  - Operating income up 19.2% to $447.6M (13.9% margin).
  - Tax rate 24.6% (vs. 22.9%).
  - Net income up 17.8% to $340.8M.
  - Diluted EPS up 23.5% to $6.68, including a $0.02 tax benefit from stock-based compensation.

- Full-year FY2022 results:
  - Net sales up 18.3% to $10.2B, driven by beauty category resilience, price increases, new brands/innovation, more social occasions, and fewer COVID-19 constraints.
  - Comparable sales up 15.6% (transactions +10.8%, average ticket +4.3%).
  - Gross profit up 20.1% to $4.0B; gross margin up to 39.6% (fixed cost leverage, other revenue, channel mix), partially offset by higher shrink and lower merchandise margin.
  - SG&A up 16.2% to $2.4B; SG&A rate improved to 23.5% (lower marketing and incentive comp leverage), partially offset by wage and strategic corporate investments.
  - Operating income up 26.3% to $1.6B (16.1% margin).
  - Tax rate 24.4% (vs. 23.9%).
  - Net income up 26.0% to $1.2B.
  - Diluted EPS up 33.5% to $24.01, including a $0.07 tax benefit from stock-based compensation.

- Balance sheet:
  - Cash and cash equivalents: $737.9M at Q4 end.
  - Merchandise inventories: $1.6B, up $104.2M (new stores, brand launches/expansions, cost increases).

- Share repurchases:
  - Q4: 722,457 shares for $328.1M.
  - FY2022: 2.2M shares for $900.0M.
  - $1.1B remaining under $2.0B authorization as of Jan 28, 2023.

- Store footprint and activity:
  - Q4: 12 new stores, 1 relocation, 12 remodels.
  - FY2022: 47 new stores, 12 relocations, 20 remodels.
  - Total stores: 1,355; 14.2M square feet at FY end.

- FY2023 outlook:
  - Net sales: $10.95B–$11.05B.
  - Comparable sales: +4% to +5%.
  - New stores (net): 25–30; remodels/relocations: 20–30.
  - Operating margin: 14.7%–15.0%.
  - Diluted EPS: $24.70–$25.40.
  - Share repurchases: ~ $900M.
  - Effective tax rate: ~24.6%.
  - Capital expenditures: $400M–$475M.
  - Depreciation and amortization: $245M–$250M.
